<div style="width:78%;margin:0 auto;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#E0DBE5 0.6px,transparent 0.6px);background-size:18px 18px;padding:1.1em 1.1em;border-radius:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.6em;">

  </div>
 </div>

 <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5em 1.9em 1fr;gap:0.7em;align-items:center;background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(58,125,201,0.22);padding:0.55em 1em;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(58,125,201,0.1);text-align:left;">
  <div style="width:1.5em;height:1.5em;border-radius:50%;background:#DCE9FA;border:1px solid #A6C4EA;color:#3A7DC9;font-family:'Maple Mono',monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:0.55em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">2</div>
  <div style="width:1.9em;height:1.9em;border-radius:0.5em;background:#DCE9FA;border:1px solid #A6C4EA;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#3A7DC9;"><i data-lucide="file-plus-2" style="width:0.95em;height:0.95em;stroke-width:1.9;"></i></div>

 </div>

  <div style="width:1.9em;height:1.9em;border-radius:0.5em;background:#E5F2EE;border:1px solid #BCDFC0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#2C8475;"><i data-lucide="bot" style="width:0.95em;height:0.95em;stroke-width:1.9;"></i></div>
